newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch PTT shelves Toppak EBS buy.
newsitem.headline: Dutch PTT shelves Toppak EBS buy.

text.p: Dutch post and telecoms group PTT Nederland NV said on Friday its PTT Post division had abandoned plans to acquire Dutch mail-order services firm Toppak EBS.
"After careful consideration, both companies have concluded that the goals cannot be achieved by the merger within the envisaged period," PTT Post said in a statement.
It added it would continue its existing commercial and operational cooperation with Toppak EBS.

PTT Post said in August it had agreed in principle to buy the firm, which employs 115 people and specialises in the storage, packing and distribution of books, CDs and video tapes for publishers and mail order companies (fulfilment). It said then it expected to finalise the deal in October.
